locator: I q.11 a.3 co., second proof: Impossibile est ergo esse plures Deos
interpretation: The conclusion of the second proof, read as being about the prima via's first mover: there is at most one first mover moved by none. Derived in result AQUINAS-ST-I-Q11-A3-ONE-FIRST-MOVER. The first proof (from simplicity, needing q.3 a.3) and the third (from the order of the world) are not formalized.
